notes.title: 1.0.05 Update| Multi-language support
notes.content:
[list] 
[*] Added multi-language support. ( PS: [i]Due to time and budget constraints, the translation quality may not be perfect. We hope for your understanding.[/i]）
[*] Lampwick Ring: Players who have defeated Red Boy can directly obtain it in the 6th stage. 
[*] Fine-tuned the perfect timing range for "Disrupt" (Counter Move). 
[*] Increased invincibility frames and the Burning Blade value for perfect counterattacks with the "Dagger" weapon type. 
[*] Optimized running cancel. 
[*] Optimized some levels return points. 
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.04 Update Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Ring: Lamp Wick Ring, obtained by defeating Red Boy, providing a transition for mid-to-late game adventures for newly added characters.
[*] Adjusted Skill: Slash Stick, moved to the position of the Wolf Vanguard in Chapter 1; players who haven’t obtained it can challenge again to unlock.
[*] Adjusted Skill: Slash Stick, unlocks charging stages based on level.
[*] Reduced the skill multiplier for Boss Ren Shen Jing.
[*] Nerfed the grab detection for Boss Yu Long Wang.
[*] Adjusted some air walls.
[/list]
